text:
Priya N: quick heads-up — new ranker bringup shows a step in NDCG when queries hit ~128 tokens vs 129. seeing a big bucketed gap on the holdout.
Marco: can you paste the bucket numbers and which holdout?
Priya N: holdout=prod_sample_v2 (10k). ndcg@10 qlen<=128: 0.412 → qlen>=129: 0.396. MRR slightly up for longer queries. :thinking:
Ben: hmm fp16 or int8 run?
Priya N: PTQ int8 hybrid (per-matmul). fp16 baseline delta is much smaller (0.412 → 0.408).
Marco: suspect tokenization boundary when query+doc concat crosses the block boundary — delimiter differences could change token alignment.
Priya N: yup. offline eval harness uses "\n\n" between query/doc, prod path uses a single space for speed. that can add/subtract a subtoken at the seam which cascades.
Ben: can you repro with a tokenizer debug? e.g. run a quick encode around the breakpoints.
Priya N: ran probe. for a subset (~2%) the "\n\n" path injects one extra subtoken at qlen=128, shifting subsequent token ids.
Marco: combined with int8's sensitivity to head/key alignment and rotary/relative pos, that shift could amplify score changes.
ops-bot: deploy notice — canary 3->4 rolled at 2026-03-20T22:10Z (no errors).
Priya N: plan: 1) canonicalize delimiter to "\n" in prod harness, 2) run a fine-grained sweep qlen 120..140 step 1 for fp16 vs int8, 3) record per-query token diffs and top-k rerank flips. I'll kick off sweep tonight.
Ben: add metrics: ndcg@1/5/10, top1-flip-rate, distribution of per-query delta. save worst offenders for manual triage.
Marco: try alternate mitigation: zero-pad queries up to 150 instead of truncating to see if kv-cache alignment reduces noise.
Priya N: starting sweep now — ETA ~6h. will post interim logs here.
Ben: if delimiter fixation closes >50% of gap, we should patch runtime and add a unit test that checks token parity between harness/prod for canonical delimiter.
Priya N: quick update (1791112280): first pass done. switching delimiter to "\n" shrank int8 gap; ndcg delta across buckets now ~1.1% (was ~2.4%). remaining drift looks like quantization noise concentrated on tail tokens.
Marco: good signal. can you drop top 30 per-query deltas into rerank-goldset for human inspection?
Priya N: done; uploaded samples and tokenized diffs. link: <http://internal/cc/1791112222/results>
Ben: great. next: run mixed-precision PTQ (keep final layers fp16) to see if tail noise reduces.
Priya N: queued mixed-precision sweep. filing a tiny PR to canonicalize delimiter + add presubmit token-parity test. cc @platform-qa
platform-qa: saw the PR — we'll add an automation check to fail on token parity mismatch between harness and prod config.
Marco: if mixed-precision fixes remainder, we can proceed with Dedicated rollout. if not, we might need model-level calibration.
Priya N: thanks all. logging this as follow-up action items in the eval ticket. will update thread when mixed-precision results are in. :hourglass:
